description: Local-first search, resume, handoff, usage tracking, and bulk session management for AI coding sessions.
notes: This package follows the customized nonlog/Recall fork. Automatic upstream release merging is disabled; upstream sync is manual only.
TUI multi-select: Insert, Ctrl+Space, or Space while the search box is empty.
Delete moves selected/current sessions to Recall trash; Ctrl+D permanently deletes them. Each action uses one batch confirmation.
Sources use distinct terminal colors and Unicode marks for easier visual identification.
